messages:
omar_sales: Heads up - Nexa returned our MSA/DPA with redlines and said procurement will only issue a PO before the Order Form is countersigned. Their asks: Net30 payment term, explicit PO->OrderForm reference, expanded auditor access, and an HSM requirement. POC onboarding blocked until PO is in. Link they sent: https://nexa.share/redlines.pdf

jess_ops: If we start on PO-only we need clear guardrails. Ops will require: 1) documented PO referencing the OF number, 2) signed acknowledgement of a short-term Use Agreement Addendum, 3) billing contact + tax id. Can we agree on a short addendum window?

mira_legal: I propose a "Use Agreement Addendum" (21 days). Key points: provisional access limited to 21 days, audit access scoped to read-only log extracts via our portal, liability capped at trial credit, and automatic expiry if MSA not signed. Will draft and aim to upload redline within hours. Avoid broad auditor language.

leo_finance: Finance can accept PO as trigger for provisioning if PO includes billing entity and tax id. Net30 is OK once entity validated. Otherwise require a small prepay equal to 30 days estimated usage or a credit cap. Ask customer to send PO PDF to billing@redwood.com.

kai_sec: Security notes: SOC2 Type II summary available. We do not publish an HSM attestation today. For the POC, recommend KMS placeholder + short retention (14d), exports disabled, and no external key material. If they insist on HSM, route to Private deployment (ETA ~3w).

ash_platform: Ops implementation: we can provision a dedicated sandbox with the following defaults: `retention_days:14`, `exports_enabled:false`, `role_restrictions: poc-team-only`. Provision ETA ~4 business days after PO + billing + addendum ack. If HSM required later, expect perf delta and +2-3w.

omar_sales: Customer says PO will be sent today and will reference OF-NEXA-210. They said they can sign the 21-day Addendum. I'll push them for exact billing contact and attach the PO PDF here when received.

mira_legal: I'll post the Addendum redline (short) and a 1-paragraph ops exhibit to make enforcement easier. If they push for broader audit scope we escalate to GC.

leo_finance: Action items: Mira -> draft addendum; Leo -> prepare billing validation checklist; Kai -> assemble SOC2 summary + HSM note; Jess/Ash -> reserve infra slot; Omar -> get PO PDF and billing contact.

omar_sales: Thanks team. If PO arrives I'll drop it here and tag billing. If any exec escalation needed I'll ping. :thumbsup:
